secondary_processes.label: Energy
secondary_processes.logic: Separate quantitative family; never arithmetically added to material mass.

secondary_processes.label: Distribution / Transport
secondary_processes.logic: Not a primary material-transformation node. May act between multiple stage transitions; consumes energy and can output emissions.
secondary_processes.rule: Do not use total transport energy/emissions as manufacturing distribution without freight/commodity attribution.

final_product_end_of_use_logic.purpose: Build Use / Consumption → End of Use from final-product discard/collection statistics.
final_product_end_of_use_logic.classification_rule: A product-specific discard/collection statistic is evidence that manufactured matter passed through use and entered an end-of-use pathway.
final_product_end_of_use_logic.critical_caution: Do not sum different years/geographies/methodologies into a claimed total unless a valid shared balance_group explicitly permits it.

distribution_decision.reason: Distribution is primarily a transport/logistics service rather than a universal material transformation.
distribution_decision.future_visual_logic: Use freight/service ribbons, energy inputs and CO2 outputs when freight-specific data are available.

emissions_mapping_logic.source_family: ONS GHG by SIC 2007 industry group

stage_examples.Use / Consumption: Product-specific operational emissions only where relevant

emissions_mapping_logic.rule: Independent stage CO2/CO2e ribbons only after documented SIC-stage mapping; avoid double counting.

balance_rules.rule: A ribbon may be quantitative while the overall stage remains incomplete.

node_geometry.node_height_rule: Geometric envelope from highest attached ribbon top to lowest attached ribbon bottom.
node_geometry.node_width_rule: Narrow/consistent; wide enough to contain flat ribbon terminations.

routing_rules.normal_flows: Smooth large-radius curves with elongated horizontal tangents at node entry/exit.
routing_rules.loops: Route outside backbone; no hard kinks.
routing_rules.terminal_sinks: Low-opacity coloured interaction zones + hatch overlay + expanded hover target.
